UserDocument.title: UserDocument
UserDocument.description: UserData document containing isolated prescription history, schedule, profile, and settings for an authenticated user

scans.description: List of scanned prescription records with detected medicines, notes, and metadata

schedule.description: List of scheduled medication items including dose timings, frequency, start/end dates, and taken/skipped statuses

profile.description: User profile details including name, patient ID, age, gender, blood group, and allergies

settings.description: User preferences including language, voice reminders, notification preferences, and theme mode

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user-isolated prescription history, schedule, profile, and settings
